interface.name: swc_snap

description.summary: raw screen capture into client buffers

interface.description: gives a screen capture capability where the client supplies a wl_shm buffer and the compositor fills it with a raw frame.

entry.name: overlay_cursor
entry.summary: composite the current cursor into the frame

entry.name: unsupported_buffer
entry.summary: buffer is not a wl_shm xrgb/argb8888 buffer

entry.name: size_mismatch
entry.summary: buffer dimensions are too small for the screen

request.name: capture

description.summary: capture a frame into a client buffer

request.description: captures the current primary screen into the supplied wl_shm buffer. The compositor writes raw pixels and reports ready or failed state

event.name: buffer
event.description: describes the current frame geometry and pixel format expected by the capture stream

event.name: ready
event.description: the requested buffer has been filled and is ready for client

event.name: failed
event.description: the capture request failed, the object still usable and the client may retry with another buffer or after a mode change
